checked.claim: A card that read '?' for a masked killer is served or rewritten with the name in clear once the mask has ended, because the GM keeps unmasked words and the mask is applied at the moment of serving.
checked.why: Read the whole road. The posting GM's own copy and its author's hold are cut with wordsFor(game.user.id), and namesHiddenFrom answers [] for a GM, so the GM's store keeps the real name (html and lines). sendWords cuts each connected reader's copy at posting time, so those readers keep '?'. answerWordsRequest cuts the held words with wordsFor(sender.id) at the time of the ask; nameMask is mask-gm.mjs namesHiddenFrom (registered by registerMasks), which reads masked tokens now; masksAtNewTimeOfDay ends the mask on drpgTimeOfDayChanged and restorePatch sets the flag false, after which no name is hidden. remember stores nothing of the mask. updateSecret takes words the caller holds (reroll.mjs markReplacedCard uses secretHtml on the GM, i.e. the unmasked words) and cuts them for each reader at the time of the rewrite. Looked for a guard: none in answerWordsRequest, none in updateSecret, no per-entry mask. Tests: R7403 sets a stand-in mask at one moment; R5001 and the tier-2 catch-up tests (39720-39744, 40721-40763) set no mask; no test ends a mask between a post and a return. A player opening the game on a second device asks for every wordless card at ready, so the case is not limited to a dropped connection. Severity kept at major: the precondition (a missed card and a return after the time of day) is ordinary at an online table, and what goes is the answer the mask exists to hide.

checked.claim: The season reset's per-bedroom SYNC.gather packets are merged by the bus's coalescer, so only the newest batch's tokenIds are panned to.
checked.why: placeCast sends one broadcast(SYNC.gather, {room, scene, tokenIds}) per batch after each awaited teleportInto. Every kind goes through one coalescer (apply = coalescer(...)), whose push merges field by field with the newest winning, within coalesceMs of the last push and at most 3x that after the first. The gather row runs the camera once with the merged data, and panToGathered pans only to this client's own token among tokenIds (and only when canvas.scene is the merged scene). No separate road pans after the reset: teleportInto passes pan: false. Scenario 65 U0 checks one room (the Hall), one batch, so it does not pin the opposite; tier 0 (14094-14095) reads only the order. Whether two teleports finish inside 120 ms on a real server is not measured; the mechanism is confirmed from source and the severity minor already reflects a particular situation.

checked.claim: Which rooms hold a concealed stash, and whose, is in region flags every browser holds, and no world-secrets rule names it.
checked.why: drpgStashes [{actorId, concealed}] is a region flag, read by stashesOn on any client; the module's own player-side code reads it there (stash-reach.mjs:240-249, 739-740), so the data is on the player's browser by design. WORLD_SECRET_RULES keys flags by Actor, User, Token, ChatMessage and Item (world-secrets.mjs:46-50) and names no Region or Scene flag; a grep for stash or concealed in world-secrets.mjs finds nothing. A comparable secret - the passages' map - was moved into the GM stores (gm-stores.mjs:191 passageMapStore), which this one was not. The comment at vault-store.mjs:1576-1582 accepts world data as readable, but it speaks of the found marks and predates D2 and E05; no stage paper or decision recording the owner's choice was found. Severity minor kept: it takes a console read, and the stash's contents stay behind the GM's check.
